brief:
The Gaza petroleum authority announced Sunday that five trucks carrying cooking gas have entered the besieged enclave, Shehab Wire reported. The shipment marks a rare fuel delivery into the territory, where civilians face acute shortages of basic supplies including fuel for cooking and heating.

The authority did not specify the origin of the shipment or the circumstances that permitted its entry through border crossings. Cooking gas remains a critical commodity in Gaza, where access to fuel has been severely restricted for extended periods.
